name: amfx-eurusd-volume-by-tod-research
description: amFX reproduction (24JAN23 p1): EURUSD spot volume by time of day (hourly buckets, UTC). Shows four structural volume spikes: (1) London open ~7-8 UTC, (2) US data releases ~13:30 UTC, (3) Options expiry ~14-15 UTC, (4) WMR Fix ~16 UTC (the largest spike). Computed from 1-minute EURUSD data averaged by hour of day.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURUSD VOLUME BY TIME OF DAY (24JAN23 p1)
# =============================================================================
# Original chart shows indexed volume by time of day with 4 labeled spikes:
#   1. London open (~7 UTC / 2am NY)
#   2. US data releases (~13:30 UTC / 8:30am NY)
#   3. Options expiry (~14-15 UTC / 9-10am NY)
#   4. WMR Fix (~16 UTC / 11am NY) - LARGEST spike
# We use 1-minute EURUSD data, extract hour of day, and average volume.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# Volume and hour extraction from 1-min bars
vol = src.v
hour_of_day = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour)(index())

# Use hour as label for xy_bars aggregation
# agg=Mean averages volume across all days for each hour bucket
xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='EURUSD Volume by Hour of Day (UTC): Where Is the Fix?',
    category='FX Volume',
    x_axis_label='Hour (UTC)',
    y_axis_label='Avg Volume (ticks)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Volume', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(vol, label=hour_of_day)
